issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: red_wall_banner, cracked_stone_bricks, mossy_stone_bricks, red_banner.
stone_bricks is 58 % of the build: break it up with a second material.

visual.summary: Keep level 2: crenellations, red banners and a watch turret make it a proper castle keep.
problems: Level 3 only adds vines over level 2: give it its own feature, such as timber hoardings (wooden galleries) on the towers or steep dark conical roofs on two of them.
It is grey stone brick almost everywhere (56 to 58 %): a dark oak timber element (hoarding, gate canopy, roof) would tie it to the rest of the kingdom's look.
On level 1 the tower tops are open boxes; even a simple slab cap or a stair parapet would make them look finished.

issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: dark_oak_fence, dark_oak_slab, mossy_stone_bricks, cracked_stone_bricks, candle, red_wall_banner, gold_block, red_banner.
2065 blocks, over the landmark budget of 1800 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.roof: turret caps pagoda-like; the great hall's steep gable roof is good

visual.summary: Level 2 adds the great hall Carlton asked for behind the keep, with a steep dark roof and the throne on a dais inside, a walled forecourt in front and red banners on the turrets. Symmetric and clearly bigger than L1.
problems: The turret caps are stepped tiers with a wide flared skirt, which reads more like a pagoda than a medieval tower: make them steep cones (a stair ring with one block of overhang, then 3 or 4 rings narrowing by one each step, finished with a slab and the flagpole), so they are taller than they are wide
Our QC renders of a structure this big are washed out by fog (renderer, not the build); judged from the near parts

notes.roof: The automatic 'no overhang' warning is a false alarm: the great hall roof overhangs the long side walls by one block in the renders (the buttresses and flower beds along the walls confuse the check); the gable ends have a dormer and trim.
notes.levels: Clearly new at a glance: the 9 x 13 great hall with throne dais behind the keep and the walled forecourt with gate in front.
notes.life: Flower beds under the hall windows and between the buttresses, lantern posts by the side doors, banners on the turret finials and the keep door.

visual.summary: Level 2 is the royal court: the keep plus a buttressed great hall behind it (two hearths, long tables, red carpet, throne on a dais) and a low walled forecourt with a gate, side gateways and posterns.
problems: Reachability: 1239 of 1432 places reached; unreached are the turret cones, the belt-course stairs, the tie beams under the hall roof (y8) and single tops of the low forecourt wall and props, which is right. Every room, the hall and the roof deck are reached.
